Thomas Paine, Essays, edited by Moncure D. Conway.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/essays

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Paine (annotator, author), died 1809.
- Moncure D. Conway (annotator, editor), died 1907.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Essays were published between 1776 and 1797 by Thomas Paine. Threadable sponsored the production of this ebook for Standard Ebooks. It was produced by Robin Whittleton, and is based on a transcription produced in 2010 by David Widger for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from the Internet Archive. The cover page is adapted from Thomas Paine, a painting completed circa 1792 by Laurent Dabos. The cover and title pages feature the League Spartan and Sorts Mill Goudy typefaces created in 2014 and 2009 by The League of Moveable Type. The first edition of this ebook was released on April 22, 2021, 9:39 p.m. You can check for updates to this ebook, view its revision history, or download it for different ereading systems at standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-paine/essays. The volunteer-driven Standard Ebooks project relies on readers like you to submit typos, corrections, and other improvements. Anyone can contribute at standardebooks.org.').
